_about: Search golden set (ADR 0003 §6 gate 2, §7.6). A seeded web-shop project of test cases, checklist items and bugs — mostly English, a few in Ukrainian and Russian, as real projects are — and queries in EN/UA/RU (about a third each) covering exact words, typos, ids, translations and paraphrases. 'expected' lists the refs a person would call a correct answer; recall@5 is measured against them. Do not tune queries to pass: add a query when search misses something real, and record the measured value in tests/test_search_golden.py.

2. Enter a valid email and password
3. Click Sign in

checklist.objective: Password field masks the characters and offers a show/hide toggle
Remember me keeps the user signed in after the browser restarts
Email confirmation link activates the account
Cart badge counter matches the number of items
Shipping cost is recalculated when the delivery country changes
PayPal payment returns the customer to the order confirmation page
Autocomplete suggestions appear after typing three letters
Out-of-stock products cannot be added to the cart
Footer links are aligned and do not overlap on narrow screens
Header stays sticky while scrolling long pages
Checkout renders correctly in Firefox, Chrome, Safari and Edge
Images have alt text and contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1
Product images are lazy-loaded below the fold
Session cookie has Secure and HttpOnly flags
Shipping notification email contains the tracking number
Phone number field accepts international format with +
Order status changes from Paid to Shipped are shown to the customer
Dates are formatted according to the selected locale
Промокод не можна застосувати двічі до одного замовлення
После смены пароля все остальные сессии завершаются
Swipe gestures change images in the product gallery on tablets
The /api/orders endpoint returns 401 without a token
